/**
 * The glossary: one source for every term the Context pane uses (ported from design/glossary.js, wording kept).
 * The pane's Explain and Glossary views and `/tokens learn` read it. Each term: what it is, its live value in this
 * session (from L, the live numbers), and what to do. A live line built from a missing number is dropped by the
 * caller (see glossaryFor in register.js), never shown as "undefined".
 *
 * Writing rules: no "turn" or "prefix"; every term says why you would care; at most two sentences before the action.
 */
export function GLOSSARY(L) {
  return [
  { group:'Basics', terms:[
    { id:'context', name:'Context',
      what:'Everything Claude reads before it answers: your messages, its replies, tool output, and the instructions and tools that load with every conversation.',
      live:`${L.used} of ${L.win} tokens (${L.pct}%).`,
      todo:'Keep one task per conversation, so it stays small.' },
    { id:'window', name:'Context window',
      what:'The most Claude can hold at once. Near the end it compacts on its own, and answers get slower and dearer before that.',
      live:`${L.win} tokens for this model.` },
    { id:'tokens', name:'Tokens',
      what:'The unit Claude reads and bills in. A token is roughly three quarters of a word.',
      live:`This conversation is ${L.used} tokens.` },
    { id:'requests', name:'Messages and requests',
      what:'You send a message; while working on it Claude makes a request each time it uses a tool. Every request reads the whole context again.',
      live:`${L.requests} requests so far this session.` },
    { id:'estimate', name:'Estimates (≈)',
      what:'Money figures are worked out from your rate per million tokens. Your bill is the real number.',
      live:L.api ? `At ${L.rate} per million input tokens.` : 'Subscription: shown as tokens and share of your 5-hour window, never dollars.' },
  ] },
  { group:'Working memory', terms:[
    { id:'messages', name:'Messages',
      what:'Your messages, Claude’s replies and the results of the tools it used. The part that grows as you work.',
      live:`${L.messages} (${L.messagesPct}).`,
      todo:'Start a fresh conversation when the topic changes.' },
    { id:'mcp', name:'MCP tools',
      what:'Descriptions of the tools your connected MCP servers offer. They load with every request, used or not.',
      live:`${L.mcp} (${L.mcpPct}) from ${L.mcpServers} servers.`,
      todo:'/mcp: turn off the servers you do not use here.' },
    { id:'deferred', name:'Deferred tools',
      what:'Tools that load only when Claude first uses one. Until then they cost nothing, so they show a dash instead of a share.',
      live:`${L.mcpDeferred} MCP and ${L.sysDeferred} system tools waiting.` },
    { id:'skills', name:'Skills',
      what:'A one-line description of each skill you have, so Claude knows it can use it. The full skill loads only when used.',
      live:`${L.skills} from ${L.skillCount} skills.`,
      todo:'/loadout: park the skills you never call.' },
    { id:'system', name:'System prompt and system tools',
      what:'Claude Code’s own instructions and built-in tools. The same in every conversation; you cannot trim them.',
      live:`${L.system} + ${L.sysTools}.` },
    { id:'memoryfiles', name:'Memory files',
      what:'CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and rules files. Loaded into every conversation, so every line costs on every request.',
      live:`${L.memory} from ${L.memoryCount} files${L.memoryTwice ? '; one is loaded twice' : ''}.`,
      todo:'/memory: drop the duplicate, and keep these files short.' },
    { id:'buffer', name:'Autocompact buffer',
      what:'Room kept free so Claude can write its summary before the window runs out.',
      live:`${L.buffer} reserved.` },
    { id:'free', name:'Free space',
      what:'What is left before auto-compact starts.',
      live:`${L.free} left.` },
  ] },
  { group:'Cache', terms:[
    { id:'cache', name:'Prompt cache',
      what:'Anthropic keeps a copy of your conversation for a while after each request. Reusing that copy costs a tenth of reading it fresh, and Claude starts answering sooner.',
      live:L.cacheLine,
      todo:'Reply while it is warm, and avoid changes that break it (switching model, editing CLAUDE.md, turning MCP servers on or off).' },
    { id:'warmth', name:'Warm, cooling, cold',
      what:'Warm: the copy is there. Cooling: under five minutes left. Cold: it lapsed, so the next request pays to store everything again.',
      live:L.cacheState },
    { id:'ttl', name:'Cache lifetime',
      what:'How long the copy lasts after it was last used: five minutes, or an hour on some plans. Every reuse starts the clock again.',
      live:`${L.ttl} on this session.` },
    { id:'recache', name:'Re-cache',
      what:'Storing the whole conversation again after the cache lapsed. It costs 1.25 times the normal price, on every token.',
      live:L.api ? `Would cost ≈ ${L.coldCost} right now.` : `Would re-process ${L.used} right now.` },
    { id:'hit', name:'Hit rate',
      what:'How much of the last request came from the cache. High is good; a sudden drop means something broke it.',
      live:`${L.hit}% on the last request.` },
    { id:'keepwarm', name:'Keep-warm',
      what:'While you are away, the plugin sends a tiny request just before the cache lapses, so it stays warm. API billing only; it stops after a few tries.',
      live:L.api ? (L.keepWarmOn ? `On: ${L.pings} of ${L.pingCap} pings used this break.` : `Off: ${L.keepWarmWhy}.`) : 'Off: a subscription already keeps the cache for an hour.' },
  ] },
  { group:'Actions', terms:[
    { id:'clear', name:'Clear',
      what:'Starts a fresh conversation. Free and instant, but Claude forgets everything not written down.',
      todo:'Write a handoff first.' },
    { id:'compact', name:'Compact',
      what:'Replaces the conversation with a summary, so you keep going with less. It reads everything one more time, so it is cheap only while the cache is warm.',
      live:L.cacheWarm ? 'Warm now: compacting is cheap.' : 'Cold now: Clear is cheaper.' },
    { id:'handoff', name:'Handoff',
      what:'A short note of where you are and what comes next, so a fresh conversation picks up without you explaining again.',
      todo:'Write one before you Clear.' },
    { id:'marks', name:'Marks',
      what:'Your thresholds. At watch, note decisions as you go; at handoff, write one and Clear; at compact, compact while warm.',
      live:L.nextMark,
      todo:'Change them in thresholds.json.' },
    { id:'autocompact', name:'Auto-compact',
      what:'Claude Code compacts on its own near the end of the window, whether the cache is warm or not.',
      live:`At ${L.auto}%.` },
  ] },
  { group:'Savings', terms:[
    { id:'saved', name:'Saved',
      what:'Tokens the plugin itself kept off your bill this session: trimmed output, compactions it vetoed, and keep-warm net of its pings. Claude\'s own prompt cache is not counted.',
      live:L.api ? `${L.saved} tokens ≈ ${L.savedUsd}.` : `${L.saved} tokens.` },
    { id:'cut', name:'Cut % of input',
      what:'Saved, divided by what you would have sent without the plugin.',
      live:`${L.share}% this session.` },
    { id:'cachereads', name:'Prompt cache',
      what:'Tokens Claude served from its own cache at a tenth of the price. That happens with or without the plugin, so it is shown for context and never counted as saved.',
      live:`${L.cacheRead} read this session.` },
    { id:'trimmed', name:'Trimmed output',
      what:'Long tool output cut to its start and end before Claude reads it. What was cut never enters the conversation, so it is never sent again.',
      live:`${L.keptOut}, kept out of ${L.keptRequests} requests.` },
    { id:'rewrites', name:'Quiet rewrites',
      what:'Noisy commands changed to their quiet versions before they run, such as git status with short output.',
      live:`${L.rewrites} this session.` },
    { id:'blocked', name:'Cold compaction blocked',
      what:'The plugin stops a compaction that would pay to store everything again while the cache is cold.',
      live:`${L.vetoes} blocked, ${L.vetoTok} saved.` },
  ] },
  { group:'Billing', terms:[
    { id:'api', name:'API billing',
      what:'You pay per token. The pane shows dollars, worked out from your rate.' },
    { id:'subscription', name:'Subscription',
      what:'Your plan has usage limits instead of a bill. The pane shows tokens and your share of the 5-hour window, never dollars.' },
    { id:'window5h', name:'5-hour window',
      what:'Your plan’s rolling usage limit. When it is full you wait for it to reset.',
      live:`${L.windowUsage}% used, resets in ${L.windowResets}.` },
  ] },
]
}
